rounds.question: Name someone in your life you hope never writes a tell-all book
rounds.hint: Who has known you well enough to tell stories about you?

rounds.question: Name something a toddler leaves fingerprints all over
rounds.hint: Picture a surface at a small child's eye level.

rounds.question: Name something kids fight over at a birthday party
rounds.hint: Think about what the guests have to share.

rounds.question: Name something specific that can smell like cinnamon
rounds.hint: A spice can leave its scent on more than just food.

rounds.question: Name something some kids need in order to sleep
rounds.hint: Think back to the things that made bedtime easier.

rounds.question: Name something people do with snow
rounds.hint: Picture the first afternoon after a big snowfall.

rounds.question: Name something people say to a dog
rounds.hint: Think about greeting a pet or asking it to do something.
